# Reclamation

Reclamation rooms are represented by empty sticky notes.
Only once reclamation room can appear per run.


If an investigator rolls a number they have previously gained they take the nearest number instead (if ties they choose the lower or higher value).
Once they have gained all six reclamations they instead roll for a forfeit.

Once 


## New investigators

If a completely new investigator (not a [protagonist](/the_taker_of_thoughts/literary_beings.qmd#protagonists)) joins the mystery give them a new character as described in [the investigators page](/the_taker_of_thoughts/investigators.qmd).
Then roll a number of reclamations to the number of reclamation rooms that have been previously encountered in the mystery.
